option.beginner.help: Players don't choose 3 out of 5 Region cards at the start of the game, they simply receive 3 cards.
option.expansion1.help: This expansion adds 9 regions and 8 sanctuaries, and allows up to 7 players to play.
option.starrySkies.help: This expansion adds 15 Meteorite Region cards to the deck, with new quest types.
option.beyondTheVeil.help: This expansion adds 13 Spirit cards that you can take by meeting their conditions, to slide them under your Region cards for additional resources and points.
